questions_and_answers.question: They live in an apartment just like mine.

answers.text: Viven en un apartamento igual al mío.

questions_and_answers.question: Is it very expensive?

answers.text: ¿Es muy caro?

questions_and_answers.question: On the contrary, the price isn't bad.

answers.text: Al contrario, el precio no está mal.

questions_and_answers.question: Does it face the street or the patio?

answers.text: ¿Da a la calle o al patio?

questions_and_answers.question: The street, and it has a beautiful view.

answers.text: Da a la calle y tiene muy bonita vista.

questions_and_answers.question: How many rooms does it have?

answers.text: ¿Cuántas habitaciones tiene?

questions_and_answers.question: A large living room, kitchen and bath.

answers.text: Una sala grande, cocina y cuarto de baño.

questions_and_answers.question: Doesn't it have a bedroom?

answers.text: ¿No tiene dormitorio?

questions_and_answers.question: No, but the living room is quite large.

answers.text: No, pero la sala es bastante grande.

questions_and_answers.question: In mine I have a sofa-bed.

answers.text: En la mía tengo un sofá cama.

questions_and_answers.question: Actually the apartment must be very comfortable.

answers.text: En realidad, el apartamento debe ser muy cómodo.

questions_and_answers.question: Why don't you come tonight and you can see where I live?

answers.text: ¿Por qué no vienes esta noche y así ves dónde vivo?

questions_and_answers.question: O.K. Will you let me off at the hotel?

answers.text: Muy bien, ¿quieres dejarme en el hotel?

questions_and_answers.question: I have to change my clothes.

answers.text: Tengo que cambiarme de ropa.

questions_and_answers.question: Then I'll take you and come by for you at eight.

answers.text: Entonces te llevo y paso por ti a las ocho.

questions_and_answers.question: Thanks a million. I'll be waiting for you.

answers.text: Un millón de gracias. Te espero.

questions_and_answers.question: We live in an old house.

answers.text: Vivimos en una casa vieja.

questions_and_answers.question: They live in a big apartment.

answers.text: Ellos viven en un apartamento grande.

questions_and_answers.question: What time do they open that building?

answers.text: ¿A qué hora abren ese edificio?

questions_and_answers.question: Where do you live?

answers.text: ¿Dónde vive usted?

questions_and_answers.question: Does he write the ads?

answers.text: ¿Escribe él los anuncios?

questions_and_answers.question: When do you write?

answers.text: ¿Cuándo escribe Ud.?

questions_and_answers.question: Since when have you all lived there?

answers.text: ¿Desde cuándo viven Uds. ahí?

questions_and_answers.question: Does he open the Embassy?

answers.text: ¿Abre él la Embajada?

questions_and_answers.question: I go up at eight o'clock.

answers.text: Yo subo a las ocho.

questions_and_answers.question: They go up at seven.

answers.text: Ellos suben a las siete.

questions_and_answers.question: They live near a friend of mine.

answers.text: Viven cerca de un amigo mío.

questions_and_answers.question: I live in the United States.

answers.text: Vivo en los Estados Unidos.

questions_and_answers.question: I live a long ways from the language school.

answers.text: Vivo lejos de la escuela de lenguas.

questions_and_answers.question: They want to go to the restaurant.

answers.text: Quieren ir al restaurante.

questions_and_answers.question: They want to go to the agency.

answers.text: Quieren ir a la agencia.

questions_and_answers.question: They're going to the same hotel.

answers.text: Van al mismo hotel.

questions_and_answers.question: This is the key to the house.

answers.text: Esta es la llave de la casa.

questions_and_answers.question: These are the keys to the apartment.

answers.text: Estas son las llaves del apartamento.

questions_and_answers.question: Two hundred dollars a month.

answers.text: Doscientos dólares al mes.

questions_and_answers.question: This is Mr. Molina's car.

answers.text: Este es el auto del señor Molina.

questions_and_answers.question: This is the light bill.

answers.text: Esta es la cuenta de la luz.

questions_and_answers.question: This is the gas bill.

answers.text: Esta es la cuenta del gas.
